Olga / Ben / Elena,

Thanks — I reviewed GardenPath_MSA_redline_v1.pdf and have attached Redwood_MSA_response_redline.pdf with inline comments. Summary of key points:

1) Term / Termination: we are fine with moving to an 18-month term provided the Order Form captures the committed volumes and a mutually acceptable early-termination clause (we propose pro-rata credits for unused committed units if they cancel before term end).

2) Data retention (Section 7): need to tighten the definition of "Customer Data" and add a 30-day overlap period for transition. Current redline proposes a perpetual deletion obligation that may conflict with our audit logs retention for platform operations. Suggest alternative language in line 7(b) of our response.

3) Indemnities (Section 14): GardenPath's current redline broadens the indemnity for customer-supplied models; we cannot accept open-ended indemnities for third-party models without additional discovery. Propose carving language that limits indemnity to willful misconduct and material breach.

4) Subcontractors / Data processors: add standard KMS/HSM integration note if they require managed keys — operations has told me it’s feasible but we’d need an implementation lead time.

I called out proposed wording for each of the above in the attached. I also added a small metadata section for DocuSign envelope requirements (signatory names + emails) to minimize signature rework.

If GardenPath is comfortable with our proposed edits, we can produce a clean MSA + tracked version and hand to Ben for order form pricing. Otherwise let’s triage on a quick call.

Laura Bennett
